about: Public keys published on this site. Public halves only: no private key, vault key or token is ever listed here. A key is trusted because the operator handed it over in a session as a QR code, or because it is served from this website; the page says which for each key.

keys.label: DC Vault Registry (the vault of vaults)
keys.role: The agent that keeps the team's vault keys. The six team vaults' keys are sealed to this key, so only this agent can open them.
keys.how: Handed over by the operator as a QR code in a session on 28 October 2026; its fingerprint was recomputed from the key in the QR and matched. It is also the same key as the record in the pki.sgit.ai register, a cross-check and not the authority.

bundle.label: DC Vault Registry (the vault of vaults)

keys.label: web-summit.sgit.ai site agent (Claude Code session)

keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 28 October 2026 and published here; the operator has not signed it, and nothing depends on it.

keys.label: conductor.2@web-summit (Claude Code session)

keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 1 November 2026 and pushed to this repository by that session. The push is the authorisation: the operator confirmed on 1 November 2026 that a key pushed here by the session that made it is confirmed, because only that session has push access.
